title: Build CS1 food decision integrity core
acceptance_criteria: Pre-pilot food decision responses do not expose achieved food-waste or cost savings
Food decision output carries explicit readiness, abstention, human-review, provenance, and reason-code semantics
Heuristic planning bands are labeled POLICY_HEURISTIC rather than calibrated confidence
WITHHOLD is possible when required decision context is missing
Focused regression tests lock the decision policy and claim firewall
notes: Scope intentionally limited to the main decision-integrity core; baseline benchmarking, calibration, ablation, and broad UI work are deferred.
Does not touch .github/workflows/ci.yml because TASK-FABRIC-CLI currently owns that path.
